vault_token_balance.meaning: Vault's physical token balance, which is zero while assets are invested externally

invested_assets_tracked.meaning: Whether the ShareToken contract tracks nonzero invested assets via getInvestedAssets()

outstanding_user_shares_exist.meaning: Whether users hold outstanding shares representing claims on invested assets

asset_investment_via_investassets.meaning: Whether assets are invested in external investment vaults via investAssets()

vault_unregistered.meaning: Whether the vault is unregistered while assets remain invested in external investment vaults

assumptions: The specific check present in unregisterVault() (physical token balance == 0) is not fully quoted, only described.
Whether assets were actually invested in a real transaction or only conditionally possible is not established.
Whether users actually held outstanding shares at unregistration time is not established.

unresolved.description: The report does not define a numeric value for invested_assets_tracked; only qualitative statement that getInvestedAssets() tracks invested assets is provided, so it is encoded as a grounded Boolean with no numeric binding.

limitations: Impact i2 (users unable to redeem shares and complete loss of fund access) is deferred; this plan formalizes only the direct impact i1 (vault unregistered while assets remain invested).
Result reverted in unregisterVault() after the insufficient validation is not represented as P; it belongs to the vulnerable behavior (root cause/V).
Whether totalAssets() returning zero by design is a factual state or an assumption for the scenario is not independently verified.
No code/PoC/SMT binding has been performed; symbols remain symbolic and will be bound later.
